Initial A2 trace: elections reset term/votes/progress and gather votes after log freshness checks; higher-term dispatch changes role and lower-term messages are dropped. Reset discards pending read confirmations and initializes follower progress, while leader promotion appends a current-term no-op. Election is suppressed when committed work has not yet applied, with a comment explicitly tying this to membership/quorum safety. These traces do not yet establish persistence ordering or application/membership completion. Followers copy the response context to ReadyToRead; pendingReadIndex.addReady selects a batch by exact SystemCtx. Thus a prefix request with a different context appears not to receive its own completion key. Timeout/GC exists and is contrary evidence against permanent resource retention; no execution or normative conclusion is claimed.
